title: The Day of the Stubborn Jar Lid
skyStory: Waxing gibbous in Taurus, the moon swelling like dough left near the woodstove. Taurus is the most stubborn sign in the sky, and today it has decided that every lid, zipper and frozen car door must put up a fight. Nothing will open on the first try. Saturn calls it character building. Mars has already growled at a pickle jar.

reading: Something will refuse to open for you today: a jar, a stuck window, a file that will not load. Your instinct is to wrestle it. The Tiger wants to win. Here is the Taurus secret: run it under warm water, metaphorically or literally, and wait thirty seconds. Patience opens what force cannot.

Midafternoon, a slow conversation with somebody wiser than you will turn up one gem worth keeping. Write it down. [[The Hierophant]] loves a good bit of handed-down wisdom, and you, Life Path 3, are the one who gets to pass it along later. Tell it to Nancy tonight, word for word.
joel.mission: When something refuses to open or work today, wait a full thirty seconds before trying again, and hum while you wait.
joel.omen: A jar lid that pops open with a satisfying click. It means a stuck plan is about to loosen.
joel.stoneWhy: a stubborn stone for a stubborn day

reading: Taurus is an earth sign and Capricorn is an earth sign, so today you and the moon are basically wearing matching boots. Everything you build today will be solid. Not fast. Solid. Pick one thing worth building slowly and lay the first stone.

Around 11 am, someone will push on a plan of yours, testing whether it holds. It holds. You do not need to argue. The [[King of Pentacles]] sits on a throne carved from a mountain and simply waits. You do the same, smiling the Wood Rat smile. They will come around by Tuesday.
nancy.mission: Lay the first stone of something worth building slowly, even if it is a single line on a page.
nancy.omen: A stone wall peeking through the snow. It means your foundations are stronger than you think.

together.text: Each of you picks one thing that has resisted you lately, a habit, a task, a stubborn drawer, and gives it one patient, calm attempt today. Report results by bedtime. Taurus will award a tiny golden bull to whoever was more gracious about it.

game.intro: A jar lid has won again. Patience is the theme, revenge is the subtext. Two truths and one tall tale, please.
game.prompt: Three household objects that have personally defeated you. One of them is made up.
